head: Sony a6700 app for beginners: Camera Academy teaches the camera in 15 lessons
dek: Sony a6700 Camera Academy is a new $1.99 iPhone and iPad app with 15 beginner lessons you work through with the camera in your hands. It was #86 among paid Education apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: The lessons start with the buttons and dials for a first photo. An Exposure Lab lets you try shutter speed, aperture and ISO, with step-by-step exercises. It's an independent photography guide by Alan Boyle, not an app from Sony. It came out on 23 November, needs iOS 17 or later and has no ratings yet.
means: If you just got a Sony a6700 and the menus feel like a lot, this is a paid, guided way to learn it step by step.
todo: Check the App Store listing to see whether the lessons cover what you need before you pay.
thumb_words: SONY A6700 LESSONS IN AN APP
